messages:
ava: quick note from the staging burst: fd usage balloons when we create many short-lived AsyncClient objects. looks like keepalive isn't being respected and we end up with lots of TIME_WAIT.

ava: minimal repro i used:
```py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def hit():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key=\"x\") as c:
        await c.generate(\"hi\")

asyncio.run(asyncio.gather(*[hit() for _ in range(1500)]))
```

ryan: do you see any "Unclosed client session" warnings?

ava: yes intermittent. also noticed codepaths where we call asyncio.create_task(session.close()) instead of awaiting, which seems risky.

emily: that was added in a retry patch last quarter as a non-blocking close. bad idea under high concurrency. can you confirm uvloop vs default?

ava: uvloop on staging. default loop locally shows fewer sockets but still surprising.

ryan: quick mitigation: add a ClientFactory that reuses one TCPConnector across ephemeral clients. also add pool_size and keepalive_timeout options surfaced on AsyncClient.

emily: long term: make AsyncClient.__aexit__ always await self._session.close() and wrap it in asyncio.shield to survive CancelledError, remove background create_task closes. add weakref cache in factory so accidental reuse doesn't leak.

ava: test idea: spin up local HTTPS echo server in pytest-asyncio and run 2k short clients, assert ephemeral sockets < 200 after run. add a regression that simulates CancelledError during __aexit__.

ryan: i'll add the typed signatures so __aenter__ returns AsyncClient in our stubs; also add examples/async_reuse.py showing correct reuse vs one-off anti-pattern.

emily: i'll implement the shielded close and factory with explicit .aclose() docs. also add an SDK lint rule: warn on creating AsyncClient inside hot loops.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: branch/async-connector-fix queued, unit tests pending.

ava: thanks — will rerun burst once patch lands and post results here.
